zh: 合法子串一定恰好横跨两个相邻的连续段（一段 0、一段 1，或反过来），且两边长度相等。
把字符串压缩成连续段长度序列；相邻两段长度为 a、b 时，以它们交界为中心能构成 min(a, b) 个合法子串。
扫描时维护上一段长度 prev 和当前段长度 run；字符变化时把 min(prev, run) 加入答案并令 prev=run、run=1；结束后再加一次 min(prev, run) 输出。
en: A valid substring always spans exactly two adjacent runs (a run of 0s and a run of 1s, or the other way round) with equal lengths on both sides.
Compress the string into its run lengths; two adjacent runs of lengths a and b give min(a, b) valid substrings centered on their boundary.

While scanning keep the previous run length prev and the current run length run; when the character changes, add min(prev, run) to the answer and set prev = run, run = 1; after the loop add min(prev, run) once more and print.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Compress the string into runs of equal characters; each pair of adjacent runs contributes the smaller length.

## Proof of correctness

A valid substring spans exactly two adjacent runs with equal lengths, so the number of possible starting points is the length of the shorter run.

## Complexity

O(n) time, O(1) space.
